priorityList: Use Force outside of Eclipse if your next ability is Cast Celestial Alignment
Cast Celestial Alignment if you have just cast Force unless saving to line up with Convoke
Cast Wrath to spend Dream Surge unless you will cap on Astral Power
Cast Convoke if you have cast Force and Cast Celestial Alignment and have less than 40 Astral Power
Enter Solar Eclipse or Enter Lunar Eclipse appropriate to target count by ending Cast Celestial Alignment with that filler
Spend Dream Surge using Cast Wrath unless you will cap on Astral Power
Cast Starsurge to spend Astral Power
Cast Wrath to generate Astral Power
Apply Moonfire and Apply Sunfire for substantial damage gain
Enter Solar Eclipse by casting Wrath
